subject: Trading
title: What Is an Altcoin?
description: A quick win: understand What Is an Altcoin?.

hook.text: Any cryptocurrency that isn't Bitcoin is called an altcoin. There are over 20,000 of them.

buildup.text: Some altcoins improve on Bitcoin's design. Others serve completely different purposes like smart contracts.

discovery.text: Ethereum, the largest altcoin, added programmable code to the blockchain—enabling apps built on top.

twist.text: Most altcoins fail. Over 90% of projects launched during hype cycles go to zero within a few years.

climax.text: The altcoin market is where innovation and fraud live side by side—separating them is the real challenge.

punchline.text: Twenty thousand coins. Maybe fifty matter.
